hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Notice that the sum of differences along any valid path from cell (r1, c1) to cell (r2, c2) telescopes to grid[r2][c2] - grid[r1][c1].

hints.title: Predecessor Minimum
hints.text: To maximize the score ending at (r, c), find the minimum grid value in the subgrid strictly above or to the left of (r, c).

hints.title: 2D Prefix Tracking
hints.text: Maintain min_val[r][c] as min(grid[r][c], min_val[r-1][c], min_val[r][c-1]). Update overall maximum difference with grid[r][c] minus strictly preceding minimums.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs of reachable cells takes O((m*n)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) DP table for prefix minima.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that path sums telescope, reducing the problem to finding preceding subgrid minimums.
